summary: Millicom International Cellular S.A. furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, a Q3 2026 earnings release, and a press release dated November 5, 2026. Revenue from continuing operations rose to $6.44bn from $4.15bn, aided by full consolidation of Colombia Telecomunicaciones (Coltel) following the February 6, 2026 acquisition of a 67.5% stake, plus Tigo Uruguay and Tigo Ecuador consolidated from October 2025. Net profit attributable to owners was $316m. The filing is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms are stated.
